$comment: Read-only Figma library snapshot and code mappings. `sets` includes component sets and standalone components currently on Atoms and Organisms. `compositions` records reusable code whose former source is detached or outside the live library; it is not a second library inventory. Notes document deliberate code names and API contracts.

sets.notes: The matrix is deliberately sparse: fourteen Type × Variant × State × Icon × Orientation combinations, not a full cross-product. state='default'|'hover' exposes the drawn states alongside CSS hover/focus-visible. orientation='default'|'right'|'left' preserves Right for existing secondary callers when omitted or default; other types are unchanged. Left Default 676:5490 draws ← label in Satoshi 12 regular, 1.4 line height, normal tracking and gap 4; Left Hover 676:5493 retains ← label in bold with wide tracking and gap 8. Only the decorative arrow is mirrored; accessible names never include arrows. Renders an anchor with href and a button otherwise; an aria-hidden ghost label always sizes the rest state to prevent surrounding reflow. Primary uses shadow-sm then shadow-lg. Secondary hover uses bold, Body - Small sizing and pickled-500 with wide tracking. Nav hover uses bold with extra-wide tracking; Inline hover uses tomato-600 and extra-wide tracking. Icon=ON exists only on Primary: a 28 icon, 16/12 padding and 60 × 52 frame; slot content remains its visually hidden accessible name. No timed transition is invented: the live atom subtrees have no prototype reactions.

Named ChatBubble because the set draws one bubble. user='talking-head'|'visitor' replaces the obsolete 'user' role; state='default'|'hover'|'selected' follows the sparse matrix, with hover now a Visitor state. Talking head uses neutral-100, square top-left and the live size/chat-bubble cap (531px). Visitor choices use size/chat-choice (400px) and nowrap; default/hover share neutral-white, a 2px lemon-500 stroke and fully rounded corners, with shadow-sm/shadow-lg. Selected uses lemon-200, square top-right and no shadow. Default visitor links expose hover elevation on pointer hover and keyboard focus. No invented timed transition.

Named Avatar because `user` collides with the prop it takes. The Figma user set has no max variant; Avatar adds the three max grounds from the logo set: neutral (`108:1371`, neutral-white/tomato-500), tomato (`108:1370`, tomato-100/tomato-500), and herbs (`108:1369`, herbs-100/herbs-500). Tomato is the code default, preserving the previous rendering. `all` resolves to /avatars/everyone.svg — the asset predates the Figma variant name.

The three separate artworks are not one recolourable SVG: both the circular ground and the base rectangle recolour. Avatar owns the neutral, tomato and herbs max grounds; public/favicon.svg is the neutral variant. Re-read 2026-09-22 for the /resume/cv redesign: the set gained `Variant=monochrome` (`484:2490`, `Type=chat`), exported to public/logo/chat-monochrome.svg and consumed by src/components/Logo.astro, which the 10 Sep 2026 note here claimed was deleted — it exists and is the component this set now maps to, alongside Avatar.astro and public/favicon.svg.

Seventeen icons retain their sparse Color × State matrix. Only the eight AI/social marks have hover variants (both Black and White); Cursor, Figma Make, download, share, circle, square, triangle, mail and phone are Default-only. Unsupported color or hover combinations throw rather than silently recolor or invent a state. Circle/Black and square/Tomato are implemented; triangle exists only in Herbs. Eight black AI/social SVGs and square live under src/components/assets/icons; their ink is the live neutral-black #040302 rather than the previous public asset #171613. Figma Black 389:2974 and White 389:2969 use refreshed whole-component exports with a square 16×16 canvas. The live 16×16.02746 frame is centered by trimming 0.013730049px of transparent padding at top and bottom; exported paths and strokes are unchanged. Share 377:2143 retains its 28×28 canvas and centered 14.5×16 artwork; the two connecting strokes now bind neutral-black #040302, matching the three discs. This is a paint-only whole-component export to the existing public/icons/share.svg path, not new geometry or an Icon API change. md-lemon hover retains the applied effect's four independent blurred SourceAlpha layers at offsets (0, 8), (-4, 4), (4, -4) and (0, -8), each with sigma 8 (Figma blur 16) and full-opacity lemon-500, merged behind the source including its transparent areas rather than shadowing the image rectangle or chaining shadows. The conflicting shadow STRING is recorded in outstanding.variableFindings, not applied to the unchanged hover artwork. Intrinsic export canvases include perplexity/figma 16, github/openai/linkedin 17, triangle 30 and square 19.

Each Color variant keeps its own 181 × 181 paper, 40 × 40 pin, per-variant box and offsets. Only the paper rotates; the pin stays fixed. Figma rotations herbs +5, tomato −3, lemon +2 and pickled −6 become CSS -5, +3, -2 and +6 degrees. Copy is the drawn raw #000000, not a substituted neutral. The herbs paper has an unbound scaled shadow (0 3.6330276px 14.5321102px rgb(20 17 15 / 0.08)); the other papers use shadow-md. Existing interactive tilt remains.

Front 114:568 and Back 114:567 retain 200 × 300 reference geometry and shadow-lg, with top-left square and the other corners radius-lg (16). State=small is 87 × 130.5, top-left square and other corners radius-md (8), with shadow-sm. The shared radius mechanism applies to both faces and the enhanced stage's effective clipping. Back padding stays 12 vertical/16 horizontal on neutral-100. Back H5 uses the live unbound 1.2 line height; title and summary retain raw #000000 Figma fills. Existing content-fitting, no-JS readable faces, click/tap/keyboard flip behavior and image-driven proportions remain; no library redraw changes those interaction contracts or replaces caller imagery with the design's checkerboard placeholder. Footer keeps separate Figma/GitHub marks and additionalUrl → githubUrl → figmaUrl CTA precedence.

The standalone Text component maps directly to TextSection. Its desktop surface is neutral-100 with 64 padding and corners 0/40/40/40 (top-left clockwise), bound to radius/xl. Outer maximum is 1105: 310 title + 135 gap + up to 532 body + 128 padding. The title stays fixed while the body shrinks in constrained parents. Heading is uppercase Typography/Title at 108px with 1.2 line height and text-box trimming; these are unbound style metrics, not H1 tokens. Content arrives through the unchanged heading prop and default body slot. BlankSection remains a named-content composition around it, not a separate live library mapping. The /ai instance locally overrides horizontal padding to 96 within a 1088 outer width; it does not force the full library body width. Narrow-width stacking and 24 padding are accessibility fallbacks, not newly drawn mobile variants.

Renders one position with state='default'|'pdf'. Default uses 24 content gaps, 64 bottom padding and a 581-wide content maximum; PDF content gap is 4 and its project previews are suppressed. Rail bottom padding is 16 in Default and zero in PDF; the triangle retains its exact 29.686 intrinsic box. projects entries require href/title and accept optional image/detailImage {src,alt} and optional colors with absent positions. /resume maps img_1_1 to image, img_1_2_s to detailImage, and color1 through color4 to colors. Missing artwork stays hidden. The inline CV-only preview 643:2846 replaces ProjectPreview and uses 99/44/44 by 99 artwork, 8 gap, then 12 gap to 132-wide H6 title plus secondary Explore. Date formatting remains shared through formatRange. Narrow-layout reflow is an accessibility fallback, not a Figma mobile variant.

Live name is Tech; ToolBox remains the code name. Usage=Web 114:685 has neutral-100 fill, 40 padding and corners 0/40/40/40 (top-left clockwise), bound to radius/xl. Its H2 and seven-column grid with 24 gaps across 411.302307 remain, yielding 491.302307 outer width. Usage=PDF 477:2461 remains unchanged: no fill, padding or radii, H3, 24 heading gap and eleven columns with 12 gaps across 412.529053 inside the 422-wide root. Both headings use the live unbound 1.2 line height. The twenty ordered entries use their own intrinsic Web/PDF asset geometry, not uniform 38/27 square boxes. Empty entries retain explicit placeholder labels. The existing narrow-width Web fallback is retained, not claimed as a designed mobile variant; Web surface styles do not apply to PDF.

Live name is Focus; FocusAreas remains the code name. The 419-wide library surface has neutral-100 fill, 40 padding and corners 0/40/40/40 (top-left clockwise), bound to radius/xl. The heading uses H2 (48px desktop maximum), not H1, with unbound 1.2 line height. Root gap remains 24, list gap 12 and the tomato-500 dot 8. The dot remains a before-element and the live 13px marker gap is unbound. Content is caller-supplied; no API change.

Renders one release note, not the feed. Live active node 655:3769 and inactive 115:704 contain no screenshots, so the screenshots prop, slideshow and its script remain absent. Only the inner content panel receives 64 padding and corners 0/40/40/40 (top-left clockwise), bound to radius/xl: active lemon-100, inactive neutral-100. The 16-wide rail, 95 root gap and 144 body bottom padding stay outside the painted panel; rail top inset is 4 and gap/bottom inset 24. Active copy is neutral-800, dot/date neutral-black, line neutral-black to neutral-300 and attachment lemon-500. Inactive dot is neutral-300, line neutral-200, copy/date/button text neutral-600 and attachment lemon-100. Date remains bold Mono - Small. Header/changes gap is 4 and content gap 24. Optional attachment stays outside the panel, 40 below it and right aligned. Absent fields retain their behavior, unsupported state transitions stay absent and the tools section still reads the existing tech schema field. Narrow-width reflow with 24 panel padding and reduced rail gap is an accessibility fallback, not a new variant.

NavBar is standalone component 210:1624, a neutral-black footer with white icon marks and square outer corners. Desktop reference is 1280 × 220 with 40 vertical/64 horizontal padding and a 1152 × 140 space-between inner row. Left column places the existing neutral Max Avatar (87 × 87, linked to /home with accessible name Home by user request) above Explore With, with vertical space-between and minimum gap 12. The four main links remain projects, playground, curiosity and inspiration. Right groups retain gap 96; the rightmost column uses vertical space-between with minimum gap 12 and a 12-gap about list: aboutme primary, behindthescenes and impressum secondary neutral-600. Impressum moves here from the left. Existing AI/social order, destinations, white marks and hover/focus behavior remain. The main navigation column retains the unbound 263 desktop width measured in Figma; stale invisible 'go back in time' overrides inflate it but are not rendered as labels or accessible names. Footer height remains 220, preserving playground viewport coupling. The former Mode set 210:1625 no longer exists; mode is not accepted as a compatibility alias. Existing label/class API and narrow-width wrapping remain; responsive reflow is an accessibility fallback, not a live mobile design.

ProjectBento has variant='1'..'6' (default '1') and state='default'|'hover'. title and href are required; optional hmw is the only visible project copy, while title supplies the accessible link name. images is an optional partial record of 0.8h, 0.6h_l, 0.6h_s, 1_2_l, 1_2_s, 1_1 and 1_2, each with src (ImageMetadata or string) and alt, directly matching the content keys without img_. colors is an optional eight-position tuple with optional values: the first four appear compact and all eight expanded. Missing artwork and colors are hidden, not replaced with checkerboard fixtures. Compact reference geometry is 421 × 210; expanded is 1280 × 538 with 96 side insets and 316/198 rows separated by 24. Hover, focus-visible and explicit hover state share the expanded presentation. /projects cycles the six variants, expands the active bento to page width on a black page ground and makes the other bentos invisible and noninteractive. H5/H3 use unbound 1.2 line height.

compositions.notes: The former curiosity component returns no parent or page in the live file. Retained as the reusable Avatar plus ChatBubble composition; it is not a current Organisms entry.
The live node is now Text and maps directly to TextSection. BlankSection remains the existing named-content composition around TextSection, not an additional Figma component.

unbound.$comment: Current library measurements and existing code-only exceptions. A literal transcribes the Figma value when no variable exists; a nearby token is not a substitute. Page and retained-composition geometry is outside this library read.
items: Title is 108px; Title and H1–H5 line heights are 1.2; Body - Large is 20px. These are raw local text-style metrics, not Figma variables.
ChatBubble's 2px stroke has no border-width variable.
Post-it uses a 181 × 181 paper and 40 × 40 pin with per-variant offsets and rotations; only the paper rotates. Its copy is raw #000000.
The herbs Post-it paper shadow is 0 3.6330276px 14.5321102px rgb(20 17 15 / 0.08), a scaled unbound effect rather than shadow-md.
Flipcard small is 87 × 130.5. Back title and summary use raw #000000; H5 line height is 1.2.
Project Bentos compact is 421 × 210; expanded is 1280 × 538 with 96 side insets. Large/small rows are 316/198 high with 24 between. The geometry is intrinsic artwork layout, not a new size scale.
Intrinsic icon dimensions, one-pixel divider strokes and component rotations remain direct geometry, not additions to the spacing scale.

Text retains 310/532 intrinsic columns and 135 gap, 977 inner width plus token-bound 64 padding on each side for 1105 outer maximum; the body can shrink in constrained parents. Release Notes retains 95 root gap and 1px rail stroke.
CV preview art uses 99/44/44 dimensions and 132-wide copy; Default content maximum is 581 and the mark is 29.686. Tech uses per-asset fractional geometry and 411.302307/412.529053 grid widths.

Focus retains a 13px marker gap and 419-wide reference surface. NavBar retains the 87px avatar and measured 263px desktop main column; the latter is geometry, not a token or permission to render stale ghost labels.
The existing page grid and focus ring are CSS-only source groups; neither is a local Figma variable collection.

Page decisions such as 48rem responsiveness, the sticky project image strip, print margins and playground positions are not library token values. The 2026-10-03 page refresh contract is recorded in docs/figma-handoff.md.

outstanding.$comment: Read-only synchronization findings, not instructions or authorization to mutate Figma.
variableFindings: All 79 local variables were read in seven single-Value collections: Color 32, Typography 21, Spacing 9, Radius 5, Motion 5, Elevation 4 and Size 3. Existing code-only font/weight/bold=700, line-height/none=1 and line-height/relaxed=1.4 still have no local variable counterpart.
Typography/Body - Bold renders Satoshi Bold but binds font/weight/semibold=600. Code preserves the drawn Bold face; the conflicting binding is reported.

New radius/xl (VariableID:697:526) is 40 and maps to rounded.xl=2.5rem / --radius-xl. Its WEB code syntax incorrectly says var(--radius-lg), and Android/iOS say radius.lg. Actual radius/lg remains 16; code follows the real variable name without aliases or a Figma mutation.

shadow/md-lemon STRING now says '0 8px 32px #f0e511, 0 8px 32px #f0e511', while the applied md-lemon effect still draws four opaque lemon-500 layers with blur 16, spread 0 and offsets (0, 8), (-4, 4), (4, -4), (0, -8). DESIGN.md and the shared icon filter preserve the drawn four-layer effect; this mismatch is reported, not silently applied.
size/chat-column=866 and size/chat-bubble=531 remain authoritative local variables and are restored to DESIGN.md; the obsolete proposed deletion is withdrawn.
designFindings: All sparse matrices and component APIs are unchanged in this surface refresh. Buttons, ChatBubble, Avatar, Logo, Icon geometry/API, Post-it, both CV states, Project Bentos and Tech PDF retain their existing contracts; share changes paint only. Empty image-fill frames in CV/Project Bentos do not gain CSS artwork insets merely because Figma stores unused padding.

NavBar's invisible stale 'go back in time' text overrides inflate the main column to 263px. Keep measured desktop geometry and genuine existing links without copying those bogus labels. No Figma mutation is part of this refresh.
